purpose: Natural DOS validation of the statically recovered 01F7:6DC4 WURM2 state-zero callback on W1L2.

capture.skipped_samples: The fourth sample stopped at the selector barrier and had no 6DC4 callback record.

static_resolution.listing: 6E31 CMP byte ES:[DI+0x2F],0; 6E36 JLE 6F16. Raw +0x2F=0xFF therefore takes ordinary 6F16 integration, not the 6E3A contact-response path.
static_resolution.ordinary_path: 6F16 adds the existing +0x0A velocity to +0x02, increments +0x2A, and then enters 707B.
static_resolution.contact_path: Positive raw +0x2F enters 6E3A; +0x2C selects 6E41 versus 6EBC acceleration and timer handling.
static_resolution.native_spelling: The C++ bridge stores a positive raw latch as mapBlocked=true, so its mapBlocked branch corresponds to DOS 6E3A and its false branch corresponds to DOS 6F16.
static_resolution.previous_error: The first verifier revision reversed the 6E31/6E36 JLE polarity; it predicted 0x14000 X integration for the captured 0xFF latch.
static_resolution.resolution: Corrected the address-annotated note and verifier; the captured 0x15000 integration now matches 6F16 exactly.

validation.result: OK: natural DOS WURM2 callback matches static 6DC4 contract

remaining_boundaries: A natural positive +0x2F descriptor-contact sample is still needed to validate the 6E3A acceleration branch.
The 707B target-ring path remains unobserved because DS:8806 was zero.
Presentation-only 5D60 descriptor contents and opaque response/audio tails remain outside this callback contract.
status: natural W1L2 state-zero callback contract validated; contact and target-ring variants remain explicit boundaries
